operating_notes.text: The board approved an investment of ₹55 Cr for disconnectors and drives for 362 kV Dead Tank Circuit Breakers at Vallam, Tamil Nadu, funded via internal accruals.
Q4FY26 order bookings of ₹8,610 Cr were about 5.3 times the quarter's revenue of ₹1,637 Cr.
FY26 order bookings were ₹14,780 Cr, up 37% YoY from ₹10,780 Cr in FY24-25.
FY26 order intake was ₹14,776 Cr, up 37% from ₹10,700 Cr in FY25.
State utility exposure in the backlog is under 2%; 98% is private customers, central utilities and PSUs.
Royalty and group charges were about ₹1.9 billion in FY26, roughly 3% of revenue.
Export orders were 46% of Q1FY27 order intake, with 80-90% of export orders coming from GE Vernova group entities.
Order-to-execution cycle is 18-24 months; transformer contracts carry an IEEMA commodity price escalation formula while the rest of the business builds in expected commodity costs.
Backlog mix: private customers 77%, central utilities and PSUs 21%, state utilities 2%; exports about 10-15% of total backlog.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹1,637.08 Cr (+42.0% YoY), net profit ₹351.77 Cr (+88.6% YoY).
GE Vernova T&D approved a ₹55 Cr investment to establish manufacturing capacity for disconnectors and circuit breakers in Vallam, Tamil Nadu.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹1,637 Cr (+42% YoY), PAT ₹352 Cr (+89% YoY), Q4 order bookings ₹8,610 Cr (+188% YoY); board recommended ₹10 dividend and approved ₹55 Cr Vallam capex.
GE Vernova T&D shareholders approved material related party transactions with GE Grid Solutions LLC via postal ballot.
GE Vernova T&D India Limited shared the earnings conference call recording on May 19, 2026, via its website.
GE Vernova T&D's May 19, 2026 earnings call disclosed FY26 order backlog of ₹21,460 Cr (up 49%), Q4 bookings of ₹8,610 Cr (up 188%), and mid-20s margin guidance.
GE Vernova T&D presented an investor update detailing a ₹1,000 Cr phased capex plan up to December 2028.
